title: Non-official experiment world snapshot envelope (SAVE-0)
description: Produced by the experiment Worker at a consistent event boundary; stored by web/src/experimental/save-store.ts. payload is opaque to the store. t_sim is seconds since experiment Day0 00:00; seed is an integer in [0, 2^32) as in the Worker runtime. payload_sha256 = SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of payload. See docs/experimental-save-system.md.

label.const: 非正式實驗世界／不屬於正式遊戲歷史
